TYPE 1 NARRATIVE AND PLANS FOR
             1815-21 NORTH CALIFORNIA AVENUE, CHICAGO.

The subject property is currently a vacant lot. The Applicant intends redevelop the
property with a new 4-81017 residential building with 20 dwelling units. The
Applicant needs a zoning change in order to comply with the minimum lot area and
the maximum floor area requirements of the Zoning Ordinance


      Project Description:       Zoning Change from a B3-1 to a B2-3


      Use:                        Residential building with 20 dwelling units


      Floor Area Ratio:           2,29


      Lot Area:                   12,600 Square Feet


      Building Floor Area:        28,800 Square Feet


      Density:                    630 Square Feet per Dwelling Unit

      Off- Street parking:        Parking spaces: 21


      Set Backs:                  Front: 0 Feet
                                  Side: 3'-8" south and 3'-8" north
                                  Rear (floors containing dwelling units): 30 Feet


      Building height:           47 Feet 2 Inches
